description: T3 curation in rounds (user decision 2026-10-02). Round 1 = practitioner guides, fault reviews and rule-targeted papers covering all 12 rules; later rounds are added before ingest/E5, never chosen from eval results. A urls.txt entry curates every kept URL in that list. Run: python data_pipeline/curator.py --out curated_data_v6 --excluded excluded_from_kb_v6 --skip-list data_pipeline/prefilter_v6.json --usage-log data_pipeline/curation_usage_v6.jsonl --batch data_pipeline/curation_batches_v6.json <name>

trial.note: Done 2026-10-02 with --only before batches existed (53 windows).

round4.note: 2026-10-21 (user approved): Gao 2022, the one remaining keep that may add a shallow_lunge cause (small knee flexion -> quadriceps weakness / limited ankle dorsiflexion); chosen from the keep review against the three thin rules (docs/kb/prefilter_v6_review.md 9, 9.1), not from eval results. After curating, find the item that cites Escamilla as cautioning against a LONG step and untag or delete it (it contradicts excessive_front_knee_flexion). 2026-10-24 (user approved): added Riemann 2012 (heavy load -> shallower lunge, cue depth: a shallow_lunge cause + fix; the depth loss is only 2 cm and every condition stays deeper than 90 degrees) and the Ladera Ranch common-mistakes article (cheap, about one window; forward_trunk_lean plus a 'both knees about 90 degrees' principle), from docs/kb/prefilter_v6_review.md 10. 2026-10-24 (user approved): added five common-mistakes web articles saved as .txt (docs/kb/prefilter_v6_review.md 11) - BOXROX walking lunge (shallow_lunge mistake + consequence), Experience Life (straight_back_leg cause + consequence), Attika / ATHLEAN-X / Cathe (partial_pushup mistake + consequence). ClassPass and Fitness and Power are kept but left out (same content, plus passages that contradict the cards). 2026-10-24 (user approved step 3 of the strict/v6b plan): added the elitefts 'easy lunge regression' article saved as .txt from the Wayback capture (straight_back_leg mistake + consequence + fix; docs/kb/prefilter_v6_review.md 11). After curating: do not tag the elitefts rear-foot plantarflexion cue straight_back_leg on its own; untag the Cathe 'go half-way down and hold' item and the ATHLEAN-X top-lockout items if they get partial_pushup.
